definitions.explanation: describing a relationship where contact has become rare or the emotional distance has grown

examples.english: I've become estranged from my older brother.

examples.japanese: {疎遠|そえん}になっていた⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I got a call from a friend I'd lost touch with.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{疎遠|そえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧がちだ。
examples.english: Since moving, I tend to lose touch with relatives.

notes:
FORMS:
{疎|そ} (distant, sparse) + {遠|えん} (far) → distant and far

COMMON PATTERNS:
{疎遠|そえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become estranged)
{疎遠|そえん}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (an estranged relationship)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{絶縁|ぜつえん}→絶縁：08374_zetsuen⟧ (breaking ties completely - stronger)
- ⟦{疎|うと}い→疎い：07842_utoi⟧ (estranged, unfamiliar)
- ⟦{親|した}しい→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧ (close, intimate - opposite)
- ⟦{遠|とお}ざかる→遠ざかる：14379_toozakaru⟧ (to grow distant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{疎遠|そえん} implies a gradual drifting apart, often without active hostility. ⟦{絶縁|ぜつえん}→絶縁：08374_zetsuen⟧ implies a deliberate cutting of ties, often due to conflict.
